TEXT: [FI] Master~, hoooow's this?

TEXT: [FI] Mmm, you've gotten just a bit better.

TEXT: [FI] ...Just a bit?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Just a bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] I see... still got a long way to go, huh...

TEXT:
[FI] I'll make you an excellent bride, befitting of anyone 
you marry.

TEXT: [FI] ...Hey, Master.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Why are you going so far to be nice to me?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...Do you still think that I'm suspicious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] It's true, at first I thought you were so softhearted 
that it was suspicious, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] But I was wrong. Master's not that kind of person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] I might be an idiot, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Even I can understand that much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Master, can I say something that might sound 
rude?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Go ahead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Are you alright in the head?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Why do you think so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] There's gotta be something wrong. It's just 
impossible.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] When someone's too nice, they always have ulterior 
motives. But from what I've seen, you aren't that 
kind of person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] I'm heavily indebted to you for the many things 
you've taught me, like the lesson earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Sometimes even treating me to meals too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Honestly, I like you quite a lot, Master.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...I see. Thank you, Kanako-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] That said, it's still really irritating though.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hey... Kanako-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] You said I was 'softhearted' but... that's not the case, 
you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I too have schemed about things before.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] For real? You're not lying?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, honest.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] That's why, Kanako-chan, maybe you should be 
careful around me, don't hold back, alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I've plans to make you cry if you let your guard 
down~

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Oh yeah?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] How interesting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Very well, Master. I'll take up your challenge.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] I don't know what you're scheming, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] I definitely won't lose!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Mhmm, that's the spirit, just like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Alright, since you're full of energy, let's continue.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Aye!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] After that's over, next is study time~

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Ugeh...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Good work today, Kanako-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Thank you very much, Master.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh.
[FI] ...Is it Kyousuke?

[FI] The name that flashed on the screen...

TEXT: [FI] Oh, it's just Ayase.

TEXT: [FI] Hey, it's me.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] To the one imprisoned in abominable illusions...

TEXT:
[FI] Huh? This isn't Ayase? Who is this? You prank 
calling me?

TEXT:
[FI] We, "The Dark Alliance," have Kousaka Kyousuke in 
our custody.

TEXT: [FI] Ah?

TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Wha-! W-What did you say!?[/font_size]

TEXT: [FI] "Dark Alliance".

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=44]NOT THAT![/font_size]

TEXT: [FI] W-What's wrong, Kanako-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] S-Someone strange in the head called my phone!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] They said they've taken Kyousuke hostage!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ehh!? K-Kidnapping!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Kukuku... You seem to be flustered, foolish mortal.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT:
[FI] If you want to save his sou... w-wait, what are you 
doing?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: [FI] Please convey our intentions properly!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] I said I'm doing just th- hey, stop...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] W-What the heck?

for a bit.

TEXT: [FI] ...Kanako?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Ayase!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] You're the mastermind behind the kidnapping! I

TEXT:
[FI] You're wrong! And what do you mean by 'I knew

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Making prank calls and such, you're seriously 
annoying!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] I mean, haven't you been in a bad mood for a while 
now? Ever since we met at the beach.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Well? So you've taken Kyousuke hostage?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...We had Onii-san make his way here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Tch, you better watch it, you ugly woman. If you 
dare to lay even a single finger on Kyousuke, I'll 
beat the crap out of you.

TEXT:
[FI] You went on and on about Kirino's feelings back 
then. Cut the crap already. There's no end to this.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] ...What a coincidence, Kanako. We feel the same as 
well.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Will you come to where I tell you? Alone.

TEXT: [FI] ...I'm here.
